0022600095.text: The Mavericks (0-1, 11th in the West, 5th in the Southwest and 1 game back) visit the Pacers (1-0, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central), and Dallas is on the road after a 0-1 start. Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-130 win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series. For Dallas, Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel) are out, while Jett Howard (calf) and Santi Aldama (knee) are day-to-day, with Howard a game-time decision. For Indiana, Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) is out, while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) are day-to-day and both are game-time decisions.
